references.text: The same command to walk in all the ways the Lord has commanded, so that you may live and prosper.
A parallel text summarizing the requirements: to fear the Lord, walk in his ways, love him, and keep his commands.
The same themes: keeping the commandments, loving the Lord, and walking in his ways.
A command to follow the Lord, fear him, keep his commands, and walk in his ways.
Israel's promise to walk in the Lord's ways, keep his laws, and listen to his voice.
A promise of blessing if they keep the commands and walk in the Lord's ways.
Joshua's exhortation to keep the commandments, love the Lord, and walk in his ways.
David's final words to Solomon about walking in the Lord's ways and keeping his commands.
Solomon's prayer that the people would fear the Lord and walk in his ways.
Blessed are those who walk in the Lord's law and keep his testimonies.
To fear the Lord means to hate evil.
Loving God is shown by keeping his commands.
